subject: 苏州东山杨湾轩辕宫正殿
author: Haier7917

sources.author: Haier7917
sources.note: 东山杨湾轩辕宫正殿实拍，略仰视的前右斜角；重绘调为近正面，删除树木、石狮与供器。

source_note: 实际照片为前右斜视，三间、单檐歇山及两侧壶门形窗明确；重绘调整为正面。国保按元登记，文博讲座指出明初及1655等重建修缮，故不以1338强称整个现存主体的无争议确年。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT: ONLY the Main Hall of Xuanyuan Gong, Yangwan village, Dongshan, Suzhou (轩辕宫正殿), as in Photo 2. This is a small THREE-BAY Yuan timber hall with one SINGLE-EAVE hip-and-gable roof, four frontal round columns, central paired doors, and exactly two flanking large panelled walls each with a distinctive cusped bell-shaped window outline and simple vertical bars. Both side windows have this stepped-cusped silhouette visible in the photo, NOT circular and NOT standard square. Preserve its deep broad projecting eaves, authentic upward eave corner sweep, raised decorated ridge with two end ornaments and small central finial, plain timber posts and low masonry plinth with central steps. Change the photo viewpoint to a symmetric approximately frontal elevation, preserving exact three bays and single roof. Complete the cropped rear tip only by the hall symmetry, do not add a second roof, pagoda, long wings or additional bays. Remove the stone lion, incense vessel, trees, hills, walls and background. Simplify wooden window bars to around6 finely spaced lines; simplify bracket sets to their main structural outlines. Keep ridge ornament only as spare contours. All doors, windows and under-eave space pure WHITE with no black fill or hatch. Roof planes almost completely blank: at most6 short separated tile cues total, no repeated parallel stripes, no roof tile grid. The entire eave-tip-to-eave-tip building must fit from x150 to x1386 on1536x1024canvas, complete roof and steps surrounded by generous purewhite margin. Thin delicate lines and sparse detail density identical to mother.

site_recommendation.name: 轩辕宫正殿
site_recommendation.year_note: 1350仅作元代遗构的近似排序点，不是已证实的竣工纪年；文博讲座强调元末始建、明初重建与1655鼎新。
site_recommendation.place: 江苏 · 苏州 · 东山杨湾
site_recommendation.lede: 东山杨湾的轩辕宫正殿以深远的歇山檐口覆盖三间殿身，左右窗棂嵌在起伏的壶门轮廓中。元代构架特征与明清修建痕迹共同留在这座小殿上。
facts: 国保时代列元；现存正殿经历明清重建与修缮，不能把整体现貌视作未经改动的元代原状。
殿身正面与进深均为三间，单檐歇山，中心四柱参与构成井字梁架。
此处原为祭祀伍子胥的胥王庙，民国时期改祀黄帝并称轩辕宫。
